<function name="IsVehicleBodyInWater" parent="Vehicle" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns whether this vehicle's engine is underwater or not. ( Internally the attachment point "engine" or "vehicle_engine" is checked )</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Whether this vehicle's engine is underwater or not.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
